premise: Young Deer wishes he had antlers instead of spots, until he hides in the dappled grass during hide-and-seek, head down, nibbling, and his spots make him impossible to find.
inspiration: Kipling's Just So stories (how the animal got its coat), told truly and turned toward contentment: the thing he wished away is exactly right for now.
lesson: What you have right now is just right for who you are right now.
learning: A young deer's white spots look like patches of sunlight and fade as it grows up

en-US.title: Deer and His White Spots
en-US.text: {deer:enter} Deer came walking on his long, thin legs, his coat covered in little white spots. {deer:face sad} [sad] I wish I had big antlers, he sighed. I've only got spots. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping up. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x2} [excited] Let's play hide-and-seek! You hide! {canvas:sunshine 0.7 30s} So Deer hid where the sunlight fell through the leaves in little patches. {deer:face normal} {sfx:grass} {deer:live hold} He put his head down and nibbled the grass, very still. {rabbit:live} Rabbit's ears shot up. He listened… nothing. So he nibbled a clover leaf. [curious] Where is Deer? {bird:enter} Bird flew down to look. {bird:face surprised} Where? Where? {deer:live resume} Then Deer lifted his head, flicked his ears and wagged his tail. Here I am! {rabbit:face surprised} [laughs] Your spots look just like sunshine on the ground! said Rabbit. {bird:live} Bird puffed up his chest and sang: Spots for now, antlers later, when the spots fade! {deer:face happy} [happily] Deer looked at his spots. I think I'll keep them a while, he said. {deer:hearts}

es-ES.title: Ciervo y sus manchas blancas
es-ES.text: {deer:enter} Ciervo llegó caminando con sus patas largas y finas, el pelo lleno de manchitas blancas. {deer:face sad} [sad] Ojalá tuviera astas grandes, suspiró. Yo solo tengo manchas. {rabbit:enter} Conejo llegó dando saltos. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x2} [excited] ¡Vamos a jugar al escondite! ¡Escóndete tú! {canvas:sunshine 0.7 30s} Así que Ciervo se escondió donde el sol se colaba entre las hojas en manchitas redondas. {deer:face normal} {sfx:grass} {deer:live hold} Bajó la cabeza y mordisqueó la hierba, muy quieto. {rabbit:live} Conejo levantó las orejas. Escuchó… nada. Así que mordisqueó un trébol. [curious] ¿Dónde está Ciervo? {bird:enter} Pájaro bajó volando a mirar. {bird:face surprised} ¿Dónde? ¿Dónde? {deer:live resume} Entonces Ciervo levantó la cabeza, movió las orejas y meneó la colita. ¡Aquí estoy! {rabbit:face surprised} [laughs] ¡Tus manchas parecen el sol en el suelo!, dijo Conejo. {bird:live} Pájaro hinchó el pecho y cantó: ¡Manchas ahora, y astas más tarde, cuando se borren! {deer:face happy} [happily] Ciervo se miró las manchas. Creo que me las quedo un tiempo, dijo. {deer:hearts}
